question: An engineer uses your Agent SDK tool to repair a legacy log parser and reports one problem per message over five messages. A renamed command-line option and a corrected error message were each fixed in one message with no side effects. Which conclusions about this history are correct?

options.text: The timestamp and splitter fixes kept breaking because each message was too short, so each should be resent alone with more detail.
options.reason: The guide ties the choice to whether fixes interact, not to message length, and interacting issues belong together in one message.
